title: Centre the replica grid on the origin so 512 and 1024 robots stay on the floor
summary: The first 512-robot standing diagnostic failed its clearance gate at control 2: the replica grid started at the origin and reached 44 m while the floor mesh spans plus and minus 40 m, so the column at 40 m stood on the mesh edge. The grid is now centred on the origin, which keeps every replica on the mesh up to 1024 robots at 2 m spacing and leaves the single evaluation robot at the origin. The edit changes a physics source file, so the one-robot, 128 and 512 standing diagnostics rerun from this source. The failed attempt stays retained.
next: Rerun the standing diagnostics at 1, 128 and 512 robots from this source and decide the deadline for a 1024-robot capture.
reason: A placement fix establishes no native result or accepted capability.
